Source snapshot: Perplexity AI public website and public web evidence.
Source URL: https://www.perplexity.ai/
Secondary source: https://www.perplexity.ai/enterprise

Claim: Perplexity offers an AI answer engine that returns cited answers from the web.
Claim: Perplexity Enterprise Pro is positioned for team and company use.
Claim: Perplexity has no direct AI search competitors.
Claim: Perplexity can replace all traditional search workflows without hallucination risk.
Claim: Perplexity has raised significant venture funding from institutional investors.

Company website excerpt: Perplexity describes its product as an AI answer engine that searches the web and returns answers with source citations.
Company website excerpt: Perplexity Enterprise Pro is marketed for organizations and teams that need AI-powered research with administrative controls.
Public source excerpt: Coverage of the AI search market names Google, OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, You.com, and other AI answer or search products as alternatives.
Public source excerpt: Public reporting describes Perplexity as venture-backed, with funding from institutional investors and technology executives.
Risk note: The no-hallucination and full-replacement claims require independent evaluation because public AI search products can still produce incorrect or incomplete answers.
